features.name: Subscription and Recurring Billing Module
features.description: A new module for subscription and recurring invoice handling with concepts including contracts, service commitments, and billing proposals. Allows flexible generation of invoices for extended periods.
caveats: requires understanding of new concepts and terminology
requires setup of contracts and service commitments before billing

features.name: Contracts and Service Commitments
features.description: New concept where contracts specify recurring service commitments that define what will be invoiced such as tickets, minutes, usage, or recurring services. Supports multiple linked service commitments.
caveats: service commitments must be assigned to contract before billing

features.name: Billing Proposals and Schedules
features.description: System can generate billing proposals or schedules once a contract is set up. Allows flexibility to generate next invoice, multiple invoices, or extended period invoices. Supports filtering by contracts and periods.
caveats: Existing lines tied to documents cannot be easily deleted

features.name: Space Billing Feature
features.description: Allows quantities and prices to be imported from external systems into contracts to automate the recurring billing process. Enables integration with external data sources.

features.name: Deferrals System
features.description: Revenue deferral system for subscription invoices. When posting an annual or multi-period invoice, deferrals are created automatically. Revenue can be recognized in individual periods and posted to GL or expense accounts.
caveats: deferral entries need to be released via batch job to post to GL

features.name: Contract Price Management
features.description: System supports managing prices and updating contracts. Price calculation types available include item price and item price with discounts.

features.name: Contract Renewals
features.description: System supports renewal of contracts with some automation capabilities. Allows extending contracts for continued recurring billing.

features.name: Power BI Embedded Reporting
features.description: Power BI app for embedded reporting for subscription billing module coming in minor release 25.2. Will provide analytics and visualization of subscription data.
features.status_evidence_quote: later on in the minor release I think it's 25.2 we will have a popi app which means we will have embedded reporting for

features.name: Excel Reports for Subscription Billing
features.description: Excel reports for subscription billing data to support quick analysis and custom reporting. Coming in 25.2 release.

features.name: Service Commitment Price Calculation
features.description: Service commitments support different price calculation types such as item price or item price including discounts. Prices can be calculated as a percentage of the base item price.

features.name: Billing Base Period and Rhythm Configuration
features.description: Contracts can be configured with billing base periods and billing rhythms such as annual. Allows setting how frequently and for what duration invoices will be generated.

features.name: Subscription Order Confirmation Layout
features.description: Separate word layout for subscription billing order confirmations that displays both unit prices and recurring service prices to customers.

features.name: Deferral Release Batch Job
features.description: Batch job for releasing deferral entries and moving revenue from deferral accounts to GL accounts. Allows selective release of deferrals by date range to control revenue recognition timing.

features.name: Contract Extension with Service Commitments
features.description: Ability to extend existing customer contracts by adding new service commitments rather than arbitrary line items. Allows customers to add services like premium support to existing subscriptions.
caveats: Only service commitments that support recurring billing can be added

features.name: Usage-Based Billing Data Import
features.description: Import external usage data like support tickets, consumption minutes, articles read, or electricity usage to feed into recurring invoices. Supports file-based import with step-by-step or batch processing options.
caveats: Requires setup of data supplier and item references before import

features.name: Usage Data Processing and Invoice Creation
features.description: Process imported usage data to create billing data and generate customer or vendor invoices. System allows step-by-step processing for troubleshooting or batch processing for normal operations.
caveats: System can delete data if mistakes are made during processing

features.name: Automatic Contract Mapping for Usage Data
features.description: When importing usage data without pre-existing contracts, system identifies the service commitment but provides error messages allowing users to create or extend contracts as needed.
caveats: Requires users to perform contract extensions after error resolution
